what: ORBITA, the generative instrument, inside the FM-1: three FM voices play euclidean rhythms over a scale while the screen draws their orbits. Four scenes; density, phase, FM ratio, geometry and scale on the knobs. The web version's own notes and voices.
author: Polaris Sound Lab
sounds: Own: ORBITA's FM voices (the web version's, synthesized) and its 32 DX7 voices (Polaris Sound Lab). CC0 VSCO-2 / VCSL samples kept from Felucca.
